website.note: Lists BE-Smart diagnostic (under sale/partnership review) and unspecified cancer therapeutics in development; no clinical trials disclosed.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: ProPhase Labs is a diversified diagnostics, genomics (Nebula Genomics, DNA Complete) and consumer dietary supplements (TK Supplements) company. The biopharma subsidiary ProPhase BioPharma holds rights to BE-Smart Esophageal Pre-Cancer diagnostic (laboratory developed test, not a drug) and licensed compounds LB-1 and LB-2 (Linebacker, modified myricetin) which have only in vitro preclinical data as potential cancer co-therapies. No active P1/P2/P3 drug trials.

excluded_preclinical.stage: Diagnostic LDT in development, not a drug
